_comment: THE DRIVER'S HALF OF THE RADIO. Text only, never voiced: there are three
rendered voices and they work, and a fourth would fight them for the audio
channel. Each pool answers one KIND of engineer call; see
overlay_radio.DRIVER_REPLY_POOL for which call maps to which pool.
NO PLACEHOLDERS, deliberately. The engineer's lines carry positions and
gaps that are only filled for some calls; a reply that names {pos} would
render as literal braces the first time it answered a call without one.
The engineer says the number. The driver says how he feels about it.
Nothing here mentions a championship, a season or points: RaceRoom is
online racing with no modelled season, so those would be claims nobody
can check. That half of FACTORtv's driver stayed behind on purpose.
